entities.summary: Hendrik Kraemer was a lay missiologist and figure in the ecumenical movement from Dutch Reformed Church in the Netherlands. He encouraged the Dutch to allow the spread of missionary activities outside of the Dutch East India Company-restricted area in eastern Indonesia to the rest of the archipelago.
